sloka: स तत्र मायाबलवानदृश्यो ऽथान्तरिक्षगः ।इन्द्रं मायापरिक्षिप्तं कृत्वा स प्राद्रवच्छरैः ।। ७.२९.२८ ॥
transliteration: sa tatra māyābalavānadṛśyo 'thāntarikṣagaḥ ।indraṁ māyāparikṣiptaṁ kṛtvā sa prādravaccharaiḥ ।। 7.29.28 ॥

translations.english: There, Indrajit, powerful with illusion and invisible, moving in the sky, enveloped Indra in illusion and then attacked him with arrows.
